desc:
I'm not buying it. 🤨 Girl, damn near half your spell cards in *EoSD* are Illusions. For all I know, you're probably still conjuring them. Lemme take a closer loo-

But still... maybe we're too focused on the time stop aspect that we've been missing it all this time, and that Sakuya is actually an **illusionist?** 🤔 That would explain "The World" in a non-Jojo position – when you're completely trapped in the illusion of her making.
